title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reading.body:
A man used AI technology to create explicit images of a woman by obtaining her photographs from social media without consent, then distributed them through multiple fake accounts across platforms. This is a case of AI-enabled image-based sexual abuse, where the deployment failure was the absence of any check on who could access the generative system and for what purpose. The technology itself was not restricted to legitimate uses.

The victim discovered the abuse only when informed by others that her altered images were circulating. Detection required her to report to police, who then traced the fake accounts and devices back to the perpetrator through digital forensics. It is not established what technical measures, if any, existed on the platforms or in the AI tool to prevent non-consensual intimate imagery from being created or shared.

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for creating and sharing obscene artificial intelligence-generated images of a college acquaintance. Bansal, a BTech graduate in Electronics and Communication Engineering, obtained photographs from the woman's private social media account and used AI technology to create explicit morphed images. He then distributed this content through multiple fake accounts on Instagram, Discord, and Facebook while using various Gmail addresses to hide his identity.

The victim, also 22 years old, reported the harassment to the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi after receiving anonymous messages informing her that her altered photographs and videos were being circulated on Discord servers. Police formed a team to investigate the digital evidence and traced the fake profiles back to Bansal. During questioning, he admitted knowing the victim from college and said personal resentment had motivated his actions. Investigators recovered a mobile phone, two SIM cards, and other digital evidence connected to the case, and the investigation is continuing.
